title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – The Irinjalakuda Town Co-operative Bank Ltd., Kerala - Extension of period
description: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to The Irinjalakuda Town Co-operative Bank Ltd., Kerala vide Directive No. CO.DOS.SED.No.D-01/12-22-350/2025-2026 dated July 29, 2025 for a period of six months up to close of business on January 30, 2026, which was last extended up to close of business on July 30, 2026 vide Directive No. DOR.MON.No.D-08/12.26.061/2026-27 dated April 21, 2026.
